messages:
maria-cs: Heads up — Marigold onboarding next Tues (09:00 PT). They go live with reserved capacity and want autoscale enabled + a smoke & soak load test during the handoff. Need ops + runtime owners to confirm quota numbers and a short runbook.
jordan-ops: Got it. What's the expected peak QPS and concurrency for their initial window?
maria-cs: Customer ops provided: ~600 QPS peak, burst to 1k QPS for 2–3m, average ~250 QPS. Target p95 latency <120ms for text-gen endpoints. Model: 7B dense, typical seq len 512.
lee-eng: Thanks — model/seq len helps. For 7B @512 we'll want batching tuned and KV cache priming. Recommend burst policy: allow short-term 2x burst capacity, scale down after 5m if not sustained.
sam-sre: What's the quota (reservations) number for GPUs / concurrent sessions? I need it to configure pool sizing and autoscaler thresholds.
maria-cs: They've purchased a 12-GPU pool (A100-class equivalent), reserve for ~48 simultaneous streams (our metric). They want canary -> full shift after successful soak.
olivia-se: For soak, suggest two phases: 1) smoke (10m ramp to 30% traffic) to validate correctness and fallbacks; 2) soak (60m at ~80% of expected avg QPS) to validate thermal/queue behavior. Also include a quick prompt quality check set (5 prompts) to run every 10m.
jordan-ops: Agree. I'll create a temporary autoscale policy: min_replicas=6, target_cpu=65, scale_step=2, max_replicas=18. Will add a burst window policy: allow +6 replicas for <=5m.
lee-eng: For KV priming: run prefix replay targeting 50% of cache keys before traffic shift. Plan: run replay job 15m pre-shift. Example command (k8s job):
```
kubectl run cache-replay --image=redwood/cache-replay:prod --env="TARGET=marigold" -- /bin/replay --rate 2000
```
sam-sre: For load test harness, I'll run rps profiles via k6. Quick script snippet to simulate traffic mix (75% prompt, 25% embedding calls):
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 15m load-scripts/marigold-mix.js
```
maria-cs: Who owns the canary routing & rollback policy during the shift? Need an on-call and a runbook step to flip if p95 >200ms or error-rate >1.5%.
lee-eng: I'll take runtime anchor for the canary. Can we have an automated rollback trigger tied to the tracing alerts? If alert hits, route back to fallback model and drain new sessions.
sam-sre: I'll wire the alert: latency_p95 > 200ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows OR error_rate > 1% -> trigger runbook. Will also add a manual abort signal for ops.
olivia-se: Add a quick checklist to the runbook: pre-warm KV, run smoke (10m), run prompt-quality checks, monitor cost burn, start soak (60m), validate metrics, shift traffic. I'll draft and post in shared drive.
deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: "marigold-cache-replay" — starts in 15 minutes (ID: job-51678999). :white_check_mark:
maria-cs: Timing note — client in CET, so their 09:00 PT = 17:00 CET. Ops on-call to be available 16:30–19:00 CET. @jordan-ops @sam-sre please ack.
jordan-ops: Ack — will be online.
sam-sre: Ack. Will monitor infra and alerts.
maria-cs: Perfect. I'll consolidate this thread into a short runbook and attach the test scripts. After runbook is ready I'll ping here and the handoff channel.
olivia-se: Small risk note — recommend disabling long-running background jobs (non-essential) in the pool during soak to avoid noisy neighbors.
lee-eng: Noted. Also ensure model quant settings are the same as prodvariant to avoid perf delta.
maria-cs: Thanks everyone :raised_hands: I'll post the runbook link in this thread once it's up"
